caption: Phone number removed for the web.

title: Labeled behavior clips
alt: Looping close-up clips of broiler chickens, each labeled with its behavior: drinking at a waterer, eating at a feeder, resting on litter, and walking.
caption: Sample clips from the action-recognition dataset: drinking, eating, resting, walking.

title: End-to-end pipeline
alt: Flow diagram: input video goes through stabilization, YOLOv11-Pose detection and ByteTrack tracking, clip and metadata extraction, and X3D+MLP classification, then post-processing that outputs CSV files, annotated videos, heatmaps and trajectories.
caption: The pipeline: preprocessing, detection and tracking, feature engineering, action classification, analytics.

title: X3D + metadata fusion
alt: Architecture diagram: a 32-frame clip passes through an X3D-M backbone into 512 visual features while pose metadata (velocity, distance to equipment) passes through an MLP into 64 context features; the two are concatenated into 576 dimensions and fed to a five-class classifier (resting, walking, standing, drinking, eating).
caption: X3D video features fused with pose metadata through an MLP.

title: Video stabilization
alt: Two frames of the same chicken pen side by side: the raw frame on the left has heavy motion blur; the stabilized frame on the right is sharp, with black borders from the warp.
caption: Raw handheld frame (left) vs. stabilized frame (right).

title: Tracking and action labels
alt: Overhead frame of white broiler chickens around feeders and drinkers, each with a colored bounding box labeled with a track ID, a predicted action (resting, eating, drinking, standing) and a confidence score.
caption: Every bird tracked with an ID and a predicted behavior.

title: Test-set confusion matrix
alt: Five-by-five confusion matrix for resting, walking, standing, drinking and eating with a strong diagonal; the largest confusion is standing predicted as walking.
caption: Confusion matrix on the test set.

title: Training curves
alt: Two line charts over 50 epochs: training loss falls from about 8 to below 0.5 while validation loss levels near 2; training accuracy reaches about 96% and validation accuracy about 82 to 87%.
caption: Loss and accuracy over 50 epochs.

title: Movement trajectories
alt: Plot of the pen in pixel coordinates with colored paths for individual chickens, green start points and red X end points; most birds stay clustered while a few roam widely.
caption: Individual trajectories across a session.

title: Spatial density heatmap
alt: Heatmap of the pen floor with bright hotspots where birds gathered, mostly along the top edge and around the left-center.
caption: Where the flock spent its time.

title: First homelab build
alt: Bare motherboard with a stock cooler, RAM, a graphics card and two loose hard drives wired up on top of a cardboard box on a bathroom counter.
caption: Where it started: the first build, on a cardboard box, December 2020.

title: Card detections on a table
alt: Magic: The Gathering cards spread on a wooden table with a player's hands at right; green boxes labeled 'item' with confidence scores from 0.35 to 0.97 surround the detected cards.
caption: Detector output on a cluttered real-world scene, with a confidence score on each detected card.

title: Segmented card crop
alt: A single tilted Magic card cut out from the scene on a black background, still at its original perspective angle.
caption: One detected card cut out of the scene, still at its original angle (detection confidence 0.97).

alt: The same card straightened to a flat, front-facing rectangle, ready for classification.
caption: The same card straightened to a flat, front-facing view, ready for identification.

title: COMET scores by system
alt: Grayscale horizontal bar chart of COMET scores for 15 Korean-to-English translation systems. DeepL, the baseline, is highest at 86.46, followed by Claude 86.14, DeepSeek 86.10 and GPT-5 85.89; Llama 3.2 1B is lowest at 72.06. The x-axis starts at 70.
caption: COMET scores for 15 Korean→English systems against the published English translation (axis starts at 70).
